name: EVENTS-001-F02 Find events in all calendar views

background.text: the phone time zone is UTC
the phone language is English United States

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S07 Find all-day and timed events in each calendar view

steps.text: Picnic is all-day on 2027-02-06 with description Outside
Dentist starts at 09:30 on 2027-02-06 with description Checkup
the owner opens <view> for 2027-02-06
Picnic and Dentist are represented on 2027-02-06
neither event is represented on 2027-02-05 or 2027-02-07
the owner opens Picnic details
the details show one all-day date 2027-02-06 without a requested hour
the owner opens Dentist details
the computed interval is 2027-02-06 09:30 to 2027-02-06 10:30 in UTC

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S08 Keep simultaneous events independently accessible

steps.text: Alpha starts at 09:30 on 2027-02-06 with description First
Beta starts at 09:30 on 2027-02-06 with description Second
the owner opens <view> for 2027-02-06
both events can be opened from the representation at 09:30
Alpha details show description First
Beta details show description Second

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S09 Account for every event in a populated month cell

steps.text: the owner created the 18 all-day events E01 through E18 on 2027-02-06
the owner opens Month for 2027-02-06
the date cell shows at least one of those event titles
its visible titles and any +N overflow account for exactly 18 distinct events
an overflow control is shown whenever any of those titles are hidden
the owner opens the full day using overflow if present or the date cell otherwise
Day displays 2027-02-06
every event E01 through E18 can be opened exactly once from that day
